falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 81% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below this level invalidates the bottoming pattern and suggests continuation lower, not accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 39 implies moderate fear, not panic; sustained VIX above 35 indicates systemic stress escalation that contradicts the 'bottom' signal and suggests the pattern match was to a pre-capitulation phase, not the actual bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.75% and holds there for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred with yields in retreat; a sustained surge above 4.75% indicates a bond market repricing that would likely trigger forced deleveraging in equities, invalidating the macro bottom thesis
